title: netlink-generic: Mark CTRL_CMD_NEWFAMILY frames as depended upon
description:
netlink-generic uses NEWFAMILY command control messages to associate
dynamic family IDs with family names, which is necessary for calling
the proper subdissector. Save the results in a multimap so that the
frame number history is preserved, and mark the frame with the
NEWFAMILY message as depended upon, so that if, e.g., nl80211
frames are exported the messages necessary for the association and
proper dissection are exported by default.
    
Using a multimap also fixes the (presumably rare) case of where a
dynamic ID is used for two different family names at different
points in the same capture.
    
AI-Assisted: no
